title: TypeScript engineering
summary: Review and design strictly typed TypeScript with runtime validation at trust boundaries. Read-only guidance: TypeScript delegation to workers stays disabled.

provenance.notes: Specialist and Lead use only. This repository runs TypeScript directly under Node strip-only mode, so enums, namespaces and parameter properties are called out.

inputs.name: boundary
inputs.description: Where untrusted data enters the code under review.

outputs.name: findings
outputs.description: Typing, validation and runtime-compatibility findings with the line that proves each.

workflow.step: Check that types describe runtime reality: any, unchecked assertions (as X) and non-null assertions on external data are findings.
workflow.check: Every assertion on external data is justified by a validator.

workflow.step: Find trust boundaries (request bodies, files, env, model output) and confirm each is parsed with a runtime schema such as zod before use.
workflow.check: No external value flows to a sensitive sink as an unvalidated type.

workflow.step: Confirm the code runs under Node strip-only TypeScript: no enums, namespaces or constructor parameter properties; imports use explicit .ts extensions.
workflow.check: tsc with erasableSyntaxOnly accepts the file.

workflow.step: Look for exhaustive handling of unions (switch with a never check) and for errors typed as unknown rather than any.
workflow.check: Adding a union member would fail the build.

workflow.step: Report findings by severity; do not propose runtime-affecting rewrites outside the reviewed scope.

constraints: TypeScript implementation is not delegated to local workers; this skill is for analysis and design.
Do not recommend loosening strictness to make a build pass.
Findings are advisory input to review, not approval.

examples.title: Cast on parsed JSON
examples.situation: JSON.parse(text) as Config is used directly.
examples.guidance: Replace with a zod parse that rejects unknown fields and report the unvalidated boundary as a finding.

verification: Each finding cites a file and line.
The typecheck command named in the repository passes for any suggested snippet.

task.text: Review the typescript module for any type use and missing zod validation at the boundary.
Remove enums so the file works under strip-only mode and erasable syntax.
Add generics with zod to the typescript helper.
